overview.description: The F/m Ultrashort Tax-Free Municipal ETF (ZMUN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks a market value-weighted index of investment-grade US municipal bonds with at least one year to maturity. The portfolio consists of tax-exempt bonds nearing their call dates and featuring higher coupons. ZMUN was launched on Sep 30, 2025 and is issued by F/m Investments.
